name: NAPCRG 54th Annual Meeting
organizer: North American Primary Care Research Group
description: The NAPCRG 54th Annual Meeting is the yearly research conference of the North American Primary Care Research Group, held at the Westin Harbour Castle in Toronto, Ontario. The program centers on primary care and family medicine research presentations, workshops, and networking sessions.
